headline: Grumpy Walrus was busy 8:30-10:11 PM ET: sold 1M CRAWJU for ~438 ADA (about a third of what was left) and dumped small BOLT, CLOVE-3, BabySNEK and Quantum SNEK bags, while repeating ~70 ADA buys: ~299 ASCEND (~366 ADA, bag ~340.6k), ~6.4k NIGHT, ~4.2k FLOW, ~414k MEPE, ~127k SOLADA and a new ~1.44M CHEESE position; net ADA ~-2.7k. TECHMAGE is a new swarm launch (16 coordinated buyers, pool pre-seeder, 2 snipers out), Pass. COCK side ~147.0k, 2.0% under its line. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: the payload valued only the CRAWJU, ASCEND and STRIKE legs; the trace shows Grumpy Walrus also sold BOLT, CLOVE-3 and two other small bags and opened CHEESE, so the trace stays the source of truth.
